## 6 = 7 — the sixth is the seventh, the free centre

```

plus the free centre        + 1
= seven                     6 + 1 = 7
```

why life is light: `6 = 7` is not a paradox, it is the free centre added — the socket that was
never a hole, the one they all touch and it stays free.
